Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 99, verse 1:

﴿When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake﴾ it is moved for the establishing of the Hour; ﴿its earthquake﴾, its violent shaking, appropriate to its greatness.

And the earth brings forth its burdens

Its treasures and its dead, and casts them out onto its surface.

Surah 99 (al-Zalzalah), verse 3:

﴿And man will say, "What is wrong with it?"﴾ — meaning, the disbeliever in the Resurrection, denying that state (of the earth).
﴿On that Day﴾ is a substitute (badal) for "when" (idha) and its answer, ﴿she will report her news﴾, meaning she will inform about what was done upon her, of good and evil.

﴿Bi-anna﴾ (because) ﴿Rabbaka awha lahā﴾ means: because your Lord inspired it, that is, commanded it to do so. And in a hadith: "She will testify against every male and female servant concerning everything they did upon her back."

﴿On that Day, people will depart from the place of reckoning﴾, [they will turn away from the place of reckoning], ﴿in scattered groups﴾, [dispersed], some taking the right-hand path to Paradise and some taking the left-hand path to the Fire. ﴿That they may be shown their deeds﴾, i.e., their recompense, of Paradise or of the Fire.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 99, verse 7:

﴿So whoever does an atom's weight of good﴾ [i.e., the weight of a small ant] ﴿will see it﴾ [i.e., will see its reward].
﴿And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it, will see its recompense.﴾
